description: This file contains test cases for functions related to outbound media handling in the LINE messaging platform, including URL validation, media kind detection, and media resolution logic.

methods.name: detectLineMediaKind
methods.description: Determines the media type ('image', 'video', 'audio') based on MIME type string.

methods.name: resolveLineOutboundMedia

methods.name: validateLineMediaUrl
